import numpy as np
from numpy import linalg

# Test case 1: complex128 with Frobenius norm
A1 = np.array([[1., 0, 1], [0, -2., 0], [0, 0, 3.]], dtype=np.cdouble)
result1 = linalg.cond(A1, p='fro')
probe('cond_cdouble_fro_dtype', float(result1.dtype.itemsize * 8))  # Record dtype size
probe('cond_cdouble_fro_is_complex', float(np.iscomplexobj(result1)))
probe('cond_cdouble_fro_value', float(np.abs(result1)))  # Value should be ~4.699

# Test case 2: complex64 with inf norm
A2 = np.array([[1., 0, 1], [0, -2., 0], [0, 0, 3.]], dtype=np.csingle) * (1 + 1j)
result2 = linalg.cond(A2, p=np.inf)
probe('cond_csingle_inf_dtype', float(result2.dtype.itemsize * 8))
probe('cond_csingle_inf_is_complex', float(np.iscomplexobj(result2)))
probe('cond_csingle_inf_value', float(np.abs(result2)))

# Test case 3: complex64 with 1-norm
A3 = np.array([[1., 0, 1], [0, -2., 0], [0, 0, 3.]], dtype=np.csingle)
result3 = linalg.cond(A3, p=1)
probe('cond_csingle_1_dtype', float(result3.dtype.itemsize * 8))
probe('cond_csingle_1_is_complex', float(np.iscomplexobj(result3)))
